products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI, CIK 0001075124) that describes itself as delivering technology with purpose, aimed at helping professionals in legal, tax, accounting, trade compliance, risk, and government sectors make faster decisions and work more efficiently. Its platform spans research, analysis, drafting, and compliance tools grounded in what the company characterizes as authoritative content and rigorous data governance.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, which it describes as built on principles of "Fiduciary-Grade AI" and designed for legal professionals needing defensible, defensible outputs. CoCounsel integrates with Westlaw and Practical Law content and is positioned for litigation support, legal research, and complex multi-step workflows. The site notes that global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP deployed the next generation of CoCounsel Legal in August 2026, and that a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase its litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also announced in August 2026 the launch of Thomson, described as the company's first proprietary large language model developed in-house. A separate connected platform, ONESOURCE+, brings together tax, trade, legal, and risk functions under an AI-powered approach.

The held facts confirm Thomson Reuters maintains a tracked product profile for CoCounsel under the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted considerations around attorney work product risk. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
